lines.zh: 靴底泡了海水，走一步响一声。
lines.en: My boots are soaked with seawater; each step squelches.

lines.zh: 我在甲板的旧痕上走，像还认得路。
lines.en: I walk the deck's scars as if I still know the way.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾露在靴外，我不在乎。
lines.en: My toes stick out of my boots; I do not care.

lines.zh: 帽檐滴水，一路湿到肩。
lines.en: Water drips from my hat brim down to my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我绕着他们走一圈，点一遍数。
lines.en: I circle them once, counting every head.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，死人不需要赶路。
lines.en: I walk slowly; the dead need not hurry.

lines.zh: 身后跟着一串湿脚印，很快干。
lines.en: A line of wet prints follows me and dries fast.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的影子，没有偏。
lines.en: I walk over your shadow without straying.

lines.zh: 船在远处，可我的腿还记得摇晃。
lines.en: The ship is far, but my legs remember rolling.

lines.zh: 我走在最前面，这是船长的规矩。
lines.en: I walk at the front; that is the captain's rule.

lines.zh: 我站着听风，风里没有海。
lines.en: I stand and listen; there is no sea in the wind.

lines.zh: 我清了清喉咙，里面全是沙。
lines.en: I clear my throat, and it is full of sand.

lines.zh: 我的骨头在衣领下轻轻敲着。
lines.en: My bones rattle softly beneath my collar.

lines.zh: 这地方离岸太远了，我不习惯。
lines.en: This place is too far inland for my liking.

lines.zh: 我哼半句，剩下半句忘了。
lines.en: I hum half a verse and forget the rest.

lines.zh: 我的船员在附近，我能听见他们。
lines.en: My crew is nearby; I can hear them.

lines.zh: 我按着帽子，怕风把它带走。
lines.en: I hold my hat, afraid the wind will take it.

lines.zh: 有一枚硬币卡在我肋骨里，很多年。
lines.en: A coin has been lodged in my ribs for years.

lines.zh: 我数着天花板上的裂缝，像看海图。
lines.en: I count cracks in the ceiling like a chart.

lines.zh: 我抬头，看见的不是星星，是桅杆。
lines.en: I look up and see masts, not stars.

lines.zh: 我想唱一首长的，唱到天亮。
lines.en: I want to sing a long one, until sunrise.

lines.zh: 死人不困，这点很麻烦。
lines.en: The dead never sleep, which is inconvenient.

lines.zh: 我把外套抖开，落下一些蛆虫。
lines.en: I shake out my coat and some maggots fall.

lines.zh: 我在等一条船，它不会来。
lines.en: I am waiting for a ship that will not come.

lines.zh: 船舱空了，我还在等潮水回来。
lines.en: The hold is empty; I still wait for the tide to come back.

lines.zh: 我把刀横在膝上，擦了很久。
lines.en: I lay the blade across my knees and wipe it a long while.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我盯着你的腰带。
lines.en: You stare at me; I stare at your belt.

lines.zh: 我见过你这样的眼神，在沉船前。
lines.en: I have seen that look before, just before the wreck.

lines.zh: 船长还在，钥匙在我腰上。
lines.en: The captain stands; the treasure key hangs at my waist.

lines.zh: 我摘下帽子，帽里是一窝海水。
lines.en: I take off my hat; inside is a nest of seawater.

lines.zh: 你这身衣服，还带着活人的味。
lines.en: Your clothes still carry the smell of the living.

lines.zh: 我在猜，你会先跑还是先求。
lines.en: I am guessing whether you will run or beg first.

lines.zh: 你比上一个高一点，也瘦一点。
lines.en: You are taller than the last one, and thinner.

lines.zh: 我的眼球转得慢，你别急着走。
lines.en: My eyeballs turn slowly; do not hurry off.

lines.zh: 你手上没有刀，我有点失望。
lines.en: You carry no blade, which disappoints me.

lines.zh: 我认得你的靴子，是镇上的手艺。
lines.en: I know your boots; town-made, that stitch.

lines.zh: 你还有多久会下来陪我们？
lines.en: How long before you come down to join us?

lines.zh: 我向你行礼，很规矩的那种。
lines.en: I bow to you, quite properly.

lines.zh: 你砍进我的肋骨，拔不出来了。
lines.en: You cut into my ribs and the blade sticks.

lines.zh: 疼是记得的，感觉忘了很多年。
lines.en: Pain is remembered; the feeling left years ago.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，这一步不容易。
lines.en: I step back, and that step costs me.

lines.zh: 我的外套破了个口，比肉心疼。
lines.en: My coat has a tear; that hurts more than flesh.

lines.zh: 我吐出一口海水，还剩半口。
lines.en: I cough up seawater; half of it stays.

lines.zh: 你这刀法，是跟谁学的？
lines.en: Who taught you to swing like that?

lines.zh: 我站直了，骨头才没错位。
lines.en: I straighten up before my bones settle wrongly.

lines.zh: 再砍深些，你才看得见里面。
lines.en: Cut deeper, if you want to see inside.

lines.zh: 我唱歌走调了，就是因为这一下。
lines.en: My singing went off key; that blow did it.

lines.zh: 船长也会受伤，只是不会死。
lines.en: Captains get hurt too, we simply do not die.

lines.zh: 金子？我箱子里全是泡烂的。
lines.en: Gold? My chest is full of soggy scrap.

lines.zh: 你别晃那瓶酒，我尝不出味道。
lines.en: Do not wave that bottle; I taste nothing.

lines.zh: 我早就不饿了，这不算好事。
lines.en: I stopped being hungry long ago, which is not good.

lines.zh: 拿钥匙来勾引我？我早有一把。
lines.en: Tempt me with a key? I already carry one.

lines.zh: 我什么都不要，只要一条船。
lines.en: I want nothing but a ship.

lines.zh: 你说的分赃，我连规矩都忘了。
lines.en: Your offer to split the loot: I forget the rules.

lines.zh: 活人的热闹，我看两眼就够了。
lines.en: The noise of the living satisfies me after two looks.

lines.zh: 我伸手去碰，只是出于习惯。
lines.en: I reach out to touch it, out of habit only.

lines.zh: 那枚金币响得真好听，可是没用。
lines.en: That coin rings sweetly, but it is useless.

lines.zh: 我心里想要，身体已经不想要了。
lines.en: My mind wants it; my body no longer does.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，像撞一面湿木头。
lines.en: You bump me like a wet wooden wall.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你反倒弹开了。
lines.en: I do not move; you are the one who recoils.

lines.zh: 我的手按在你肩上，很冷吧。
lines.en: My hand rests on your shoulder; it is cold, is it not?

lines.zh: 让开些，我不想把你挤进墙里。
lines.en: Step aside; I do not want to press you into the wall.

lines.zh: 我们擦身而过，我的袖子湿了你。
lines.en: We pass; my sleeve soaked your arm.

lines.zh: 这一撞，你的刀差点掉了。
lines.en: That bump nearly cost you your knife.

lines.zh: 我退一步，骨头在靴子里响。
lines.en: I step back, bones rattling in my boots.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，死人味道重。
lines.en: Do not come so close; the dead smell strongly.

lines.zh: 我等你走过去，我很讲礼。
lines.en: I wait for you to pass; I am quite polite.

lines.zh: 撞得不轻，你可以先走。
lines.en: That was a hard bump; you may go first.

lines.zh: 我的新娘留在海底，穿着绿裙子。
lines.en: My bride stayed at the bottom, in a green dress.

lines.zh: 有人给我说过亲，她跑了。
lines.en: Someone arranged a match once; she ran.

lines.zh: 我这样，连蛆都不太愿意靠近。
lines.en: Even maggots keep some distance from me.

lines.zh: 船员就是家人，可他们会散。
lines.en: The crew is family, and they do come apart.

lines.zh: 我在船头站了很多年，旁边是空的。
lines.en: I stood at the bow for years with nobody beside me.

lines.zh: 海没有嫁给我，只是把我收下了。
lines.en: The sea did not marry me; it merely kept me.

lines.zh: 我记得她的名字，只有一半。
lines.en: I remember her name, but only half of it.

lines.zh: 我唱歌给海底听，她听得见吗？
lines.en: I sing to the deep; can she hear it?

lines.zh: 我这副样子，不该再想这些。
lines.en: In this state, I should not think of such things.

lines.zh: 你要是有谁，就早点回去。
lines.en: If you have someone, go back to them early.

lines.zh: 你抬不动我，我比看上去沉。
lines.en: You cannot lift me; I am heavier than I look.

lines.zh: 我捡起你的帽子，还给你。
lines.en: I pick up your hat and hand it back.

lines.zh: 我衣兜里有一把湿的钥匙，只有一把。
lines.en: In my pocket is one wet key, only one.

lines.zh: 我弯腰捡一枚扣子，腰骨响了一声。
lines.en: I bend for a button and my spine pops.

lines.zh: 别动我腰上的刀，它比我还旧。
lines.en: Do not touch the knife at my hip; it is older than I am.

lines.zh: 我拾起银子，又扔回海里。
lines.en: I pick up silver and throw it back to the sea.

lines.zh: 你想抬我去领赏？抬不动。
lines.en: You want to carry me off for a bounty? You cannot.

lines.zh: 我把一只断手塞回袖子里。
lines.en: I push a detached hand back into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那个箱子我抬过，里面没有宝。
lines.en: I have lifted that chest; there is no treasure in it.

lines.zh: 拿走你想要的东西，别碰我的骨头。
lines.en: Take what you want, but leave my bones.

lines.zh: 我看见你了，从你把灯举起来那刻。
lines.en: I saw you the moment you raised that lamp.

lines.zh: 有一个活人走过我的甲板，够了。
lines.en: One living man crossed my deck; that is enough.

lines.zh: 我的船员饿了，我得给他们找点。
lines.en: My crew is hungry; I must find them something.

lines.zh: 你身上的热气，在这么远都看得见。
lines.en: The warmth of you is visible even this far.

lines.zh: 我按住刀柄，这对你是个坏消息。
lines.en: I grip my hilt, which is bad news for you.

lines.zh: 不用喊，我不聋，只是慢。
lines.en: No need to shout; I am not deaf, merely slow.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上有活人的味道，还有饭。
lines.en: You smell of the living, and of cooked food.

lines.zh: 这一带归我管，规矩是我定的。
lines.en: This stretch is mine; I set the rules here.

lines.zh: 我把帽子压低，认认真真地盯你。
lines.en: I pull my hat low and take a proper look.

lines.zh: 我的骨头咯了一下，这是要动手。
lines.en: My bones click once; that means a fight.

lines.zh: 又来了一个，和上个月那个一样。
lines.en: Another one, just like the fellow last month.

lines.zh: 你别跑，跑起来我就不客气了。
lines.en: Do not run; if you run I stop being civil.

lines.zh: 我举起刀，先看你的脚下。
lines.en: I raise my blade and check your footing first.

lines.zh: 船长从不漏掉一个客人。
lines.en: A captain never lets a guest slip away.

lines.zh: 你踩上我的甲板，还带着鞋。
lines.en: You stepped on my deck, boots and all.

lines.zh: 我抬了抬帽檐，算是见过你了。
lines.en: I tip my hat. That counts as meeting you.

lines.zh: 船上要人手，你看着还成。
lines.en: The crew needs hands. You look serviceable.

lines.zh: 我的钥匙在找锁，你在找路。
lines.en: My key looks for a lock; you look for a way out.

lines.zh: 我跟着你走，靴子一步不落。
lines.en: I follow you, my boots missing no step.

lines.zh: 你往左边绕，我就堵左边。
lines.en: You circle left, so I block the left.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边唱，你听得发毛。
lines.en: I sing as I walk, and it makes you uneasy.

lines.zh: 我的刀拖在地上，划出一道线。
lines.en: My blade drags the ground and scratches a line.

lines.zh: 你喘气的声音，我隔得很远都听见。
lines.en: I hear your breathing from far away.

lines.zh: 跑吧，跑了追起来才有趣。
lines.en: Run; the chase makes it more interesting.

lines.zh: 我记得这条路上的每块石头。
lines.en: I remember every stone on this road.

lines.zh: 你在门后，我就在门外等着。
lines.en: You are behind the door; I wait outside it.

lines.zh: 我不急，海底等了那么多年。
lines.en: I am in no hurry; I waited ages at the bottom.

lines.zh: 我把你的退路一个个数过了。
lines.en: I have counted each of your ways out.

lines.zh: 你越跑越慢，我看出来了。
lines.en: You are slowing down; I have noticed.

lines.zh: 我的船员把你围住了，你没看见吧。
lines.en: My crew has you surrounded; you did not notice.

lines.zh: 我要近到能看清你的脸。
lines.en: I want to get close enough to see your face.

lines.zh: 只差一条船的距离了。
lines.en: Only one ship's length remains.

lines.zh: 我走在船板左数第七块上。
lines.en: I walk the seventh plank from the left.

lines.zh: 你躲进船舱，我把门关上了。
lines.en: You duck below deck. I close the door.

lines.zh: 我哼着调子，把你往死角带。
lines.en: I hum a tune and herd you into the corner.

lines.zh: 我的船员各守一边，你中间。
lines.en: My crew holds every side but the middle. Yours.

lines.zh: 你的脚步我听得出，跑不快了。
lines.en: I hear your steps. They are slowing.

lines.zh: 我把刀立在身前，站住不动。
lines.en: I plant the blade before me and stand still.

lines.zh: 刀落下去，我听见湿的一声。
lines.en: The blade comes down; I hear a wet sound.

lines.zh: 我砍得很慢，死人不需要快。
lines.en: I strike slowly; the dead have no need for speed.

lines.zh: 这一刀是替沉船上的伙计。
lines.en: This blade is for the crew who went down.

lines.zh: 我的刀口卷了，还是能开肉。
lines.en: My edge is nicked and still opens flesh.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，手很凉。
lines.en: I seize your collar; my hand is cold.

lines.zh: 别挡，骨头的力气不好挡。
lines.en: Do not block it; bone-strength is hard to block.

lines.zh: 我笑着劈下去，牙掉了两颗。
lines.en: I swing down laughing, and lose two teeth.

lines.zh: 我的船员会跟着我一起上。
lines.en: My crew comes at you with me.

lines.zh: 我的弯刀顺着甲板的斜度落下去。
lines.en: My cutlass comes down along the slant of a ship's deck.

lines.zh: 打在我身上的地方，没有知觉。
lines.en: Where you hit me, I feel nothing.

lines.zh: 这一刀我留了手，你运气好。
lines.en: I held back on that cut; you are lucky.

lines.zh: 你的血溅到我的外套上，认出你了。
lines.en: Your blood spatters my coat; now I know you.

lines.zh: 我掐住你的喉咙，先听你说话。
lines.en: I grip your throat, to hear you speak first.

lines.zh: 我倒下去也会再站起来，记住这点。
lines.en: I will rise again after falling; remember that.

lines.zh: 我从沙里坐起来，帽子上全是泥。
lines.en: I sit up out of the sand, my hat covered in mud.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我被留在这块地上。
lines.en: The tide went out and left me on this ground.

lines.zh: 我先点了名，船员一个不少。
lines.en: I call the roll first; the crew is all here.

lines.zh: 谁把我的船开走了？没人答。
lines.en: Who sailed my ship away? Nobody answers.

lines.zh: 我拍掉身上的沙，拍不完。
lines.en: I brush the sand off me and never finish.

lines.zh: 我站起来时，膝盖响得像旧铰链。
lines.en: Standing up, my knees creak like old hinges.

lines.zh: 我闻到树林的味道，不是海。
lines.en: I smell forest, not salt water.

lines.zh: 我吹了声口哨，附近有东西应了。
lines.en: I whistle once and something nearby answers.

lines.zh: 这片地很干，我不太喜欢。
lines.en: This land is dry; I do not care for it.

lines.zh: 我按了按胸口，里面还是空的。
lines.en: I press my chest; the hollow is still there.

lines.zh: 有人把我挖出来了，我该谢谢他。
lines.en: Someone dug me up; I should thank them.

lines.zh: 我的旗子不见了，回头再找。
lines.en: My flag is missing; I will look for it later.

lines.zh: 船长回来了，先唱一句。
lines.en: The captain is back; let me sing a line first.

lines.zh: 我抬头找桅杆，只看见树。
lines.en: I look up for a mast and see only trees.

lines.zh: 我先闻到的，是松脂不是海水。
lines.en: The first thing I smelled was pine, not salt.

lines.zh: 我从一堆断桨底下爬出来。
lines.en: I crawled out from under a heap of broken oars.

lines.zh: 我的船板散在林子里，我只好走。
lines.en: My planks lie in the woods. So I walk.

lines.zh: 我拍平外套，拍出两只螃蟹。
lines.en: I smooth my coat and two crabs fall out.

lines.zh: 船员陆续站起来，队没散。
lines.en: The crew rises one by one. The line holds.

lines.zh: 有人朝我竖了根火把，我跟着来。
lines.en: Someone raised a torch at me. I followed it in.

lines.zh: 烧吧，我身上已经没有能烧的。
lines.en: Burn it; there is nothing left on me to burn.

lines.zh: 摔下去时我抓着帽子，先护它。
lines.en: Falling, I grab my hat and save it first.

lines.zh: 又沉下去，这次我认得路。
lines.en: Sinking again; this time I know the way.

lines.zh: 炸开的一瞬，我看见了海底。
lines.en: For a moment in the blast I saw the seabed.

lines.zh: 箭插在我肩上，像根桅杆。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder like a mast.

lines.zh: 那股光在我骨头里烧，很烫。
lines.en: That light burns inside my bones, very hot.

lines.zh: 饿是感觉，我早就不会饿了。
lines.en: Hunger is a feeling; I lost it long ago.

lines.zh: 雷打中我，亮得能照见船员。
lines.en: Lightning hits me, bright enough to show the crew.

lines.zh: 虚空比海深，可我还是沉的。
lines.en: The void is deeper than the sea, and I still sink.
